He works from home so work is not an issue, but he still thinks it is not fair since he already has other plans and cannot take her everywhere he goes. While it's understandable that the son has other plans, it's not unreasonable for the parent to ask him to prioritize his sister's care during this time. It's also important to consider that this is an opportunity for the son to develop his caregiving skills and bond with his sister. Of course, it's essential to have an open and respectful conversation with the son to understand his concerns and find a mutually agreeable solution. But overall, I think the parent's expectation is reasonable, and the son should be willing to help out.
